versions.changelog:
Shared Bike 0.1.0 introduces the core features for sharing bike travel guidance:

- Supports scanning QR codes to unlock HelloBike/Meituan bikes, provides riding areas and pricing instructions.
- Includes travel mode and preference filters (e.g., high-speed rail, self-driving, preferential, comfort).
- Offers info on ticket availability, real-time flight updates, weather alerts, and local tips.
- Quick response to data changes for transport hubs and inventory.
- Safety and travel reminders included.
